Find the hidden word before you run out of attempts. Every guess must exist in the selected language dictionary.

Green: right letter, right place. Gold: the letter belongs elsewhere. Gray: absent letter. Repeated letters respect the number of occurrences in the answer.

Accents are normalized. Tap a tile to edit its letter.

Apprentice and Strategist choose common words. Grandmaster uses the complete dictionary. In Duo and Quartet, solve every board using the same guesses.

Daily puzzles depend on local date, language, difficulty, and word length. Blitz lasts 120 seconds after the first valid guess.

Real words from open sources, included in the APK. Portuguese: fserb/pt-br. English: SCOWL/en-wl. The words are not AI-generated. Complete lists may include rare terms.\n\nNo connection, account, or Internet permission is needed to play.
